title: Small
text: Small. I almost didn’t order these because they were 4oz and all the spices in my cabinet are 2.5oz.  I figured they’d be way to big.  Turns out that’s not the case, they will only hold about half a jar of 2.5oz spice.  I’ll be returning them

description: The mini glass jars is great for dry herb storage and crafting.
